text:
maya: quick sync — need to freeze optimize toolkit scope for next sprint. inbound customer asks: AcmeHealth wants cache invalidation + TTL controls; Novatek pushing for quant recommendation to cut cost; ops asks for eval-triggered alerts. can we deliver?

zack: short answer: batching presets + a minimal cache UX are doable. quant adviser needs eval infra + offline scoring, that's multi-sprint.

riya: customer-impact lens: AcmeHealth pilot blocks on invalidation API. recommend ship cache + batching first, then quant advisor as alpha in following sprint.

oliver: we should also design a lightweight eval smoke to run during canary for any rollout that touches model outputs (esp quant). alerts can be simple deltas initially.

sam: from UX: TTL dropdown + an "Invalidate" control in route settings is low effort. docs + tooltip suggestions for TTLs. quant explainability can wait.

zack: rough dev estimates:
```
- batching presets: 3 dev-days (runtime)
- cache API + invalidate event: 5 dev-days (runtime + api)
- UI controls + docs: 2 dev-days (frontend + docs)
- quant advisor & eval infra: ~3w engineering work
```

maya: ok scope proposal: sprint A = batching presets + cache API + basic TTL UI + audit logs. sprint B = quant advisor + eval-triggered alerts. need acceptance criteria for sprint A.

riya: acceptance (sprint A):
- batching: provide low/med/high presets per-route; no p99 latency regression >10% on canary
- cache: per-route TTL, POST /routes/{id}/invalidate endpoint, audit log line for each invalidate
- rollout: canary to internal + AcmeHealth for 72hrs with smoke prompts

oliver: add monitoring gates: p95 latency <= 1.25x baseline; error rate delta < 0.3% over 5m windows. run 10 smoke prompts through canary to validate output sanity.

sam: UI acceptance: TTL control present, invalidate button triggers audit log entry, tooltip with 3 recommended TTLs. docs draft linked in PR.

zack: risks: invalidation semantics with prefix/shared cache can cause stale reads. plan: default eventual consistency, offer strong-consistency flag behind FF. also KV quota might block full KV-backed implementation. fallback: local in-process TTL for pilot.

maya: rollout plan (sprint A):
1) behind FF, internal rollout + automated smoke tests
2) enable for AcmeHealth canary, monitor for 72h
3) if OK, expand to a wider alpha
stop conditions: p50 latency regression >15% or error spike >0.5% sustained for 10m.

riya: for sprint B (quant advisor) gating metrics proposal:
- mean token logprob delta > 0.6 triggers an alert
- BLEU/ROUGE style overlap drop > 3% on eval set
- alert false-positive rate target < 5% (iteratively tune)

oliver: we need per-customer baselines + 90d eval retention to make alerts meaningful. store eval fingerprints by route+model version.

sam: docs: I'll draft a short FAQ on cache semantics, recommended presets, and the fallback behavior. will also include customer comms template for AcmeHealth.

zack: timeline: sprint A capacity ~= 2 engs * 2 weeks + 1 QA * 1 week. blockers: storage quota for audit logs + small schema change. fallback plan acceptable if quota delayed.

maya: owners: batching=zack; cache API=zack; UI/docs=sam+riya; eval-alerts spec=oliver. I'll update roadmap and schedule a 30m kickoff tomorrow 10:00.

maya: thanks all — landing pad documented, will post roadmap update and customer comms after kickoff :tada:
